The '''Alashan system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located on the outskirts of the known [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] in a region called [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. The system was known to contain the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alashan]], home to the ancient [[Unidentified Alashan culture|Alashans]] and the [[Sentinel (creature)|Sentinel creature]].
